name: autoresearch-local-evidence-loop
hard_boundaries: human approval is required before execution or server creation
new managed cards require a human-edited innovation review and a separate exact compute allocation

the first human review requires a source-backed SCI/SCIE journal baseline in Chinese Academy of Sciences major-category 1 or 2 with impact factor above 4, its baseline and experiment scheme, and a structured final-scheme comparison table; conferences use a separate peer-review and venue-standing record
the default research strategy is reference-first reproduction followed by one recent controlled extension; it is not an independent architecture claim and does not guarantee publication
each innovation package contains verification and ablation rows
paper conclusions require a human-reviewed evidence snapshot and exact bilingual wording
prepare.py, data, evaluator, and dependencies are protected
literature and predicted gains are hypotheses, not measured results
multi_seed records stability and does not require every seed to beat the best seed
missing evidence is recorded as TBD
